horizon_driver: paycheck-to-paycheck liquidity and the next election cycle; the collapsing job-switcher wage premium and falling quit rate reveal a shortening effective horizon as the labor market cools

constraints.action: abandon mainstream two-party political identification entirely
constraints.source: partisan identity and institutional inertia (union, church, community ties)
constraints.breaks_under: real wage growth is negative for 2+ consecutive quarters while equity/asset indices post double-digit gains

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Pre-2024 polling and rhetoric emphasized inflation and cost-of-living as the top issue, framed largely as diffuse, bipartisan anti-incumbent sentiment.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: A ~15-point swing toward Trump among voters earning under $50k in the 2024 election; for the first time since the 1960s a majority of that income bracket voted Republican (56% vs 43% for Harris). Research links this to long-term wage stagnation, not only short-term inflation.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Generalized cost-of-living discontent translated into a specific, historically unusual, and durable partisan realignment rather than diffuse anti-incumbency that would revert once inflation cooled.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: 2025-26 official and market narrative treats a record-high S&P 500 as evidence of a healthy economy.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The job-switcher wage premium collapsed from >2% in 2022 to roughly zero by 2025, quits are below 2022-23 levels, and the earnings-vs-real-economy correlation fell to about -0.4 by 2024; corporate profit margins for goods industries are ~60% above 2018-19 levels even as payroll growth lags a capex-heavy, AI-driven investment cycle.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The headline equity/GDP narrative diverges from this actor's lived wage and hiring experience, which the Cartographer correctly flags as the leading indicator, not the equity index.

tripwires.if: real wage growth is negative for 2+ consecutive quarters while a broad equity index sits within ~5% of all-time highs
tripwires.then: populist vote share among below-median-income voters rises materially within 1-2 electoral cycles, lagging the wage data by roughly 2-4 rounds per the Cartographer's note

tripwires.if: the job-switcher wage premium turns negative (switching jobs pays less than staying)
tripwires.then: quits fall further and this actor becomes more strike-prone and politically volatile even as market-based labor voice (mobility) declines

what_would_change_my_mind: A 2026-28 cycle where real wage growth recovers strongly, matching or exceeding asset returns, without any reversal of the 2024 populist realignment would falsify the wage-driven mechanism and point to identity/cultural drivers instead.
